verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only per-file sharing: user-level edit/comment/view choices, per-file permission resources that can target a domain or 'anyone', and an API sample for auditing sharing info. Nothing documents org-level admin policies restricting external sharing, domain allowlists, or tenant-wide link restrictions. Per-file permissions and audit scripts are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not the governed admin control the story asks for.

support.subject: As an IT admin, external collaboration is governed — org-level controls over who can share outside the team, with domain allowlists or link restrictions
